reporting_rules: Freeze the selected public benchmark contexts, four prompts, messages, prompt hashes, complete model-specific request order, analyzer, and gates before any trial response call.
Use all 48 exact-lookup telling contexts and a hash-selected set of 48 exact-lookup probing contexts; never replace a context after outcomes are observed.
Do not expose the human target action in generic, uniform-scaffold, or adaptive-router messages. The oracle arm is a diagnostic realization ceiling and cannot support an adaptivity claim.
Randomize each model in exact eight-stratum blocks crossing two target actions by four arms.
Train the same three conventional action classifiers only on the existing human MathDial teacher turns and apply all frozen variants to identical trial responses.
Both target-specific and aggregate paired contrasts use contexts as bootstrap clusters and treat the five models as a fixed panel.
Every classifier variant must independently pass every primary gate. Classifier variants are robustness checks, not independent samples.
Report every model, target action, arm, classifier variant, failed call, and cross-model action-consensus result regardless of direction.
The outcome is agreement with an observed human next action, not learning, response quality, or a uniquely optimal pedagogical decision.
Do not change routes, models, contexts, arms, prompts, classifiers, thresholds, or exclusions after inspecting responses.
